extracted text: The paper describes a Direct chill (DC) cast Al–12.7Si–0.7Mg alloy without chemical modification that was hot extruded and subsequently heat-treated under various conditions. The billet was extruded into a profile of 4 mm in thickness at 470 °C, after pre-heat-treatment at the same temperature for 2 h. The extrusion ratio is 15:1 and the ram speed was set at 10.5 mm/s. For T6 treatment, solution treatment was performed at 540 °C for 90 min in a salt bath and quenched into water at room temperature. Artificial aging was carried out at 180 °C for periods of 1, 2, or 3 h.
property mapping:
YS = Yield Strength (MPa)
UTS = Ultimate Tensile Strength (MPa)
Elongation (%) = elongation percentage
T1 = as extruded
T4 = solution treatment + natural aging
T6 = solution treatment + artificial aging

DC = Direct chill
